## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an exceptionally capable woman who handles her own affairs as well as those of others, maintaining an observant watch from her window over everything that passes in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Known for being farseeing and skilled at sewing, she never shirks her share of work. However, she is an outspoken, officious, and meddlesome person who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor, often nagging people to do right and remaining easily shocked by any naughtiness. Though she possesses a critical and fault-finding eye, she ultimately has a kindly heart and is considered one of the kindest souls in her community.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde had brought up ten children and buried two, and she was renowned in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for having knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts. Upon noticing [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving away from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and voiced strong disapproval after learning he and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) intended to adopt an orphan boy. She later visited to meet [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends the child by criticizing her appearance; after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flew into a temper outburst, Mrs. Rachel ultimately forgave her when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology. Mrs. Rachel continued to offer advice to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), such as advising her to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home from school until she cooled off following a punishment. Over the years, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) enlisted Mrs.

## Quotes

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde initially offends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by bluntly criticizing her appearance, prompting a furious outburst from the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatic apology at Matthew's urging, Mrs. Lynde completely forgives her and gives her flowers, laying the groundwork for a friendship. Rachel subsequently offers [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) advice on how to handle Anne's school troubles and informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her bed-jumping antics infuriated [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. - Friend of — reconciled after apology  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share a longstanding friendship and occasionally act as traveling companions, such as attending a political rally together. Despite their bond, Rachel does not hesitate to voice strong disapproval and warnings when she discovers [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) plans to adopt an orphan. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regularly consults Rachel for practical advice on raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and Rachel keeps her informed of local news and gossip.
